command: pre-registration of plan G's read G7 (DSRL)

arms.dsrls: DSRL on the per-task one-demo LoRA, 100 practice episodes
arms.dsrlz: DSRL on the frozen policy, 100 practice episodes, no demonstration

metrics.context: E3 read; DSRL on a LoRA base was a token-era baseline (archive/2026-10-program/README_demo_rows.md); a three-episode dsrlz training smoke (seed 99) preceded this registration

hypotheses.H1: E3's kept library is non-inferior to dsrlz with acceptance (task-level bootstrap 95% lower bound of library minus dsrlz+acc above -0.05)
hypotheses.H2: E3's kept library is non-inferior to dsrls with acceptance (same criterion)
hypotheses.descriptive: each DSRL arm vs zero-shot; dsrls+acc vs LoRA+acc; DSRL practice success in its first 10 and last 20 training episodes

metrics.written_before: any DSRL training or scored episode of g7
